description: This Java class 'OrderListState' manages the state of an order list in a web application, including pagination, order status, type, and filters. It provides methods for session management, updating state based on HTTP requests, and retrieving filtered order data from a database.

classes.name: OrderListState
classes.description: A session-scoped class that maintains the state of an order list, including pagination, status, type, and filters, with methods to update and retrieve order data based on current state.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's OrderListState from session or creates a new default instance.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the order list state based on HTTP request parameters, handling pagination or status/type/filter changes.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders from the database matching the current state filters, with pagination support.
